skills.name: list_research_feedback
skills.description: List recent unverified research feedback matching the running project, model and harness. Recording a problem does not diagnose or fix it.

skills.name: start_harness_refinement
skills.description: On a user request to improve the research harness, use selected feedback IDs to run real Harness² refinement with configured cloud inference in the background. Selected sanitized feedback is sent to the cloud as unverified evidence. Uses bounded isolated instruction worktrees; never changes model weights, application code, permissions or the active bundle. Returns a proposal job, not a verified fix. Inspect harness_check_status and independent checks before any adoption.
